notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {U/B}.
Pitiless Plunderer and Kels trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Kels trigger, causing you to pay {U/B} to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat.
